disclaimer: Analytical model, NOT a GPU emulator, benchmark, or real-instance performance prediction. Inputs are assumptions; inspect provenance.

assumptions: CPU-only arithmetic and deterministic pipeline scheduling. Not a GPU emulator, benchmark, or real-instance prediction.
Every device and transport numeric value is an uncalibrated hypothetical input; names describe conceptual paths, not specific products.
Memory fit, engine support, quality, queueing, availability, price, and SLOs are not evaluated.
Effective memory/compute/link utilization is held constant across shapes solely to isolate sensitivities; real utilization depends on shape and stack.
Dense transformer forward proxy with ideal balanced TP/PP partitions, two all-reduces per layer, and user-controlled extra HBM traffic.
Forward-only FIFO pipeline; distinct microbatches of independent sequences, dedicated serialized interstage links; no autoregressive feedback scheduling.

Inference replicas process additional offered work independently; no gradient synchronization. Training DP performs one bucketed gradient sync after accumulation; only final-microbatch backward work is eligible to overlap.
Flat ring for every collective. Inter-node cases assume every phase sees the selected slow bottleneck path; no hierarchical NCCL algorithm model.
Network ceiling is already directional and per rank; sharing_factor is only additional contention, not a bits-to-bytes conversion.
